title: Make AI Reproduce the Bug First (Then Fix It)
description:
Never let AI fix a bug it hasn't proven! 🐛

✅ Ask AI for a one-line repro before any fix
✅ Run it and see False: the bug is reproduced
✅ Fix it, run again, and see True: proven fixed

Day 2 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 3, Bisect a Regression with Git and AI.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #ai #aicoding #coding #programming #debugging #csharp
tags: write a repro for a bug
comment: Repro first or fix first: which would you ask AI for? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep the repro line in your project, then rerun it after every fix to prove the bug stays gone.
